2. No one appears on behalf of the applicant(s) to press this application under Section 482 Cr.P.C.
3.
Sri Ajay Singh, learned AGA-I for the State is present.

4. The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants-Manoj Raj Singh and Girraj Singh with the following prayers:
"It is, therefore, most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to quash the Charge Sheet No.164 of 2016, dated 13.09.2016 and cognizance order dated 14.10.2016 passed by Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kasganj as well as entire proceeding of Case No. 9846 of 2016, State Vs. Manoj Raj Singh and another arising out of Case Crime No.196 of 2016, Under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C., P.S.
Patiyali, District Kanshiram Nagar now District Kasganj pending in the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kasganj.

It is further prayed that further proceeding of aforesaid Case No. 9846 of 2016, State Vs. Manoj Raj Singh and another arising of Case Crime No.196 of 2016, Under Sections 498A, 323, Patiyali, District-504, 506 I.P.C., P.S. Patiyali, District Kanshiram Nagar now District Kasganj pending in the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kasganj may kindly be stayed during pendency of the present 482 of Cr.P.C. application before this Hon'ble Court and/or pass such other and further order which this Hon'ble Court may be deem fit and proper circumstances of the case."
5.

sentences.text: This matter was referred to the Mediation and Conciliation Centre of this Court vide order dated 1.3.2017 subject to deposit of Rs.30,000/-by the applicants.
As per report of the Mediation Centre dated 18.5.2017, the applicants have not deposited the said money before the Centre till 16.5.2017.
6. In view of the same, this matter is reported by the office through the report dated 3.3.2025 of Registrar (J) (Listing) that it is likely to be infructuous.

7. Perused the records.
